name: ecc
description: Harness-native ECC workflows for Codex: shared skills, production-ready MCP configs, and selective-install-aligned conventions for TDD, security scanning, code review, and autonomous development.

interface.shortDescription: Selective ECC engineering skills, guarded workflows, and an opt-out browser connector.
interface.longDescription: ECC is a harness-native operator system for Codex and adjacent agent harnesses. It packages reusable skills, MCP configs, TDD workflows, security scanning, code review, architecture decisions, operator workflows, and release gates in one installable plugin.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use only the smallest relevant ECC skill set. Define the outcome, verify changed behavior in proportion to risk, and follow repository-owned safety, test, and delivery rules.
